faits.fait: Actil is a national third-party payment platform created at the initiative of Groupe APICIL.

Actil does both third-party payment (tiers payant: the patient pays nothing upfront, insurers pay the provider directly) and a care network: negotiated offers in optical, hearing and dental care, built into its third-party payment.

Since April 1, 2021, the Actil optical third-party payment network has been open to all opticians who want to join. The optician chooses the equipment from all lens, contact lens and frame catalogs on the market.
The optical network includes large chains and independent opticians, in mainland France and the overseas regions (DROM).
From their private area on actil.com, the optician submits pricing requests (cotation) and coverage requests online.
On the optical portal, the request submitted is first a pricing request (cotation). Coverage approval comes next, by converting an accepted pricing request.
The portal finds the patient by their social security number. It does not display a list of supplementary insurers to choose from.

The Actil card must match the Carte Vitale (French health insurance card) data exactly: social security number, date of birth, birth rank and dependents. If in doubt, the optician can check coverage rights in their private area.
A coverage approval is a payment guarantee. If coverage rights are closed afterward, the payment remains valid for the health professional.
You can bill as soon as the equipment is delivered, within the following 2 years, provided you are still under agreement. Actil does not pay retroactive invoices.
Actil processes incoming files every day. Payments can be viewed in the private area, over 27 months.
Actil announces stronger security for access to the professional portal starting June 30.
Named accounts receive a one-time code by email, valid for 5 minutes, after the password.
The portal warns that after 5 failed login attempts, the account is temporarily locked.
Actil’s head office is in Lyon.

conventionnement: Fill in the form on the Contact page of actil.com.
Wait to be contacted by the Actil teams to finalize registration.
Sign the Actil agreement and provide the requested supporting documents.
After the documents are checked, receive your login for the professional portal.
Finalize registration online, then submit pricing requests and coverage requests on actil.com.

organismes.note: The Actil optical portal has no payer selector: it finds the patient by their social security number. No list is therefore recorded by Granit agents. Never write “this insurer only goes through Actil”.
